items.title: Attackers Harvest Dropbox Logins Via Fake PDF Lures
items.description: A malware-free phishing campaign targets corporate inboxes and asks employees to view "request orders," ultimately leading to Dropbox credential theft.

items.title: New GlassWorm attack targets macOS via compromised OpenVSX extensions

items.title: County Pays $600K to Wrongfully Jailed Pen Testers
items.description: Iowa police arrested two penetration testers in 2019 for doing their jobs, highlighting the risk to security professionals in red teaming exercises.
